serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings source_type='Order', maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services), service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes available for that bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure from the bucket's own work table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and site-specifically and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's "Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity", not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero
